channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que é contra privatização da Petrobras e Embrapa, mas não dos Correios
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos, from the Missão party, stated he opposes privatizing Petrobras and Embrapa, but supports privatizing the postal service and other companies he deems 'useless'.

item.title: Doleiro de Vorcaro complica a vida de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Antonio Carlos Freixo Junior, linked to Daniel Vorcaro, confirmed to the Brazilian Attorney General's Office that he transferred $69 million to the Havengate fund in the US, under investigation for money laundering. The revelation complicates matters for Flávio Bolsonaro, tied to the scandal.

item.title: André Mendonça afasta diretor-geral da PF, Andrei Rodrigues
item.description: STF Minister André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues over suspicions of illegal surveillance of government officials. The decision also removes Police Intelligence Director Leandro Almada da Costa and authorizes criminal and administrative investigations.

item.title: Renan Santos reage à decisão de Mendonça sobre Andrei Rodrigues: "Fez bem"
item.description: Candidate Renan Santos (Missão) praised Minister André Mendonça's decision to remove Federal Police Director Andrei Rodrigues during an interview on Jovem Pan radio. He described the action as positive, calling it part of an alleged 'institutional war'.

item.title: Mendonça afasta Andrei Rodrigues do comando da PF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Andrei Rodrigues, director-general of the Federal Police, and Leandro Almada da Costa, intelligence director, suspected of monitoring his activities at the STF. The unilateral decision also suspends the production of intelligence reports on judges and will be reviewed by the STF's Second Chamber.

item.title: Flávio tem 45% contra 41% de Lula em 2º turno no AP, diz pesquisa
item.description: Real Time Big Data survey in Amapá shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 45% against Lula's 41% in a potential runoff, within the margin of error. Both candidates face high rejection rates (49% and 48%), and Lula's government approval is evenly split (49% approve, 49% disapprove).

item.title: Amapá: ex-prefeito pode vencer aliado de Lula e Alcolumbre no 1º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: Real Time Big Data poll shows former mayor Antônio Furlan (PSD) leading with 62% of voting intentions in the first round, against 31% for Governor Clécio Luís (União Brasil). Victory may occur in the first round despite support from Lula and Alcolumbre for the governor.

item.title: O terceiro caminho leva ao Centrão (por Paulo Markum)
item.description: The text examines how third-way candidates in Brazil, such as Augusto Cury, rely on alliances with larger parties to remain viable, highlighting the role of Centrão. It proposes semi-presidentialism as a solution but acknowledges the difficulty of constitutional approval given the parliamentary fragility of the Avante party.

item.title: Isenção da taxa das blusinhas vai na contramão do resto do mundo
item.description: Congress approved the elimination of the 'blusinhas tax', benefiting imports of up to 50 dollars. While Brazil relaxes its rules, other countries are tightening, citing unfair competition and fraud.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (8)
item.description: Presidential candidates have a busy schedule with debates, interviews, meetings with supporters and technical visits across states like São Paulo and Brasília. Most carry out campaign activities, while the PL and PT candidates keep a private schedule. The order of presentation rotates alphabetically each day.

item.title: Club Brugge x Aston Villa na Champions League: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Club Brugge and Aston Villa face off on Tuesday, the 8th, at 1:45 PM (Brasília time) at Jan Breydel Stadium in the first round of the Champions League 2026/27 league phase, broadcast on TNT and HBO Max. The Belgian side, led by Hans Vanaken, seeks to leverage home advantage, while Aston Villa, managed by Unai Emery, aims to secure points away from home. The teams renew a recent clash where the English side claimed victories in the previous edition.

item.title: Mendonça determina o afastamento de Andrei Rodrigues da direção da PF
item.description: Justice Minister André Mendonça ordered the preventive removal of Federal Police director Andrei Rodrigues over allegations of illegal surveillance tied to the Banco Master case. The ruling also removes intelligence director Leandro Almada da Costa and suspends intelligence reports targeting judges and prosecutors. The move deepens the institutional crisis at the STF.

item.title: Renan Santos defende reforma ‘profunda’ no STF e diz que Toffoli e Moraes são ‘ilegítimos’
item.description: Renan Santos advocates for deep reforms in the STF, deeming ministers Moraes and Toffoli illegitimate, and proposes privatizing Correios while keeping Petrobras and Embrapa.

item.title: ‘Se o Flávio Bolsonaro for eleito, o Vorcaro não fica na cadeia. Eles vão combinar o que fazer com os R$ 40 bilhões que estão fora do Brasil’, diz Haddad em SP
item.description: Haddad countered Flávio Bolsonaro regarding the Banco Master scandal, stating that Lula's government liquidated the company and arrested suspect Daniel Vorcaro. He claimed the 40 billion reais overseas are managed by shell funds and questioned corruption during Bolsonaro's administration. Haddad also criticized Flávio's linkage between Lula and the STF, emphasizing the president's institutional relations.

item.title: Vídeo: Representantes dos Três Poderes participam do desfile de 7 de setembro em Brasília
item.description: Representatives from the three branches of government, including President Lula, Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, and Supreme Court Chief Justice Edson Fachin, took part in the September 7th parade in Brasília. The event, which lasted approximately 2 hours and 30 minutes, gathered thousands of people at the Esplanade of the Ministries and featured performances such as the human pyramid and the Brazilian Air Force demonstration.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Flávio Bolsonaro (46%) e Lula (45%) mantêm empate técnico no 2º turno
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and President Lula (PT) remain technically tied in the second round, with 46% and 45% of voting intentions, respectively, according to a BTG/Nexus survey released on August 8, 2026.

item.title: Crusoé: Nexus indica freio no avanço meteórico de Cury
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll published on April 8 shows a decline in Augusto Cury's (Avante) voting intentions, dropping from 8% in the spontaneous poll to 6%. In the stimulated poll, his numbers also likely experienced adjustments, interrupting the meteoric rise previously observed.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula tem compromissos no Planalto e Zema vai a reunião com emissoras
item.description: On Tuesday, the presidential candidates follow different schedules: Lula holds institutional commitments at the Planalto, while Zema attends a meeting with broadcasters in Brasília. Flávio Bolsonaro has no public agenda.

item.title: Nikolas posta foto de Lula preso nos anos 1980: “Nem precisou de IA”
item.description: Federal congressman Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) shared a historical photo of Lula arrested in the 1980s, linking it to an AI trend that recreates images with retro aesthetics. Lula was imprisoned in 1980 for promoting a strike, remaining detained for 31 days.

item.title: Lula tem 48,7% e Flávio, 42,1%, no 2º turno em MG, diz pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll released on September 8, 2026 shows Lula (PT) leading with 48.7% against 42.1% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in Minas Gerais in the runoff. The margin of error is ±2 percentage points with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula aparece à frente de Flávio Bolsonaro em MG, mostra pesquisa Atlas
item.description: A poll by AtlasIntel shows President Lula (PT) leading the vote in Minas Gerais with 44.3% in the first round, ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 35.4%. The scenario is confirmed in simulated runoffs, where Lula holds a safe lead over all opponents.

item.title: Em carta a Fachin, ministros aposentados manifestam apoio e cobram apuração 'pública' e 'rigorosa' diante de crise no STF
item.description: Thirteen retired Supreme Court justices sent a letter to Edson Fachin requesting a public and rigorous investigation amid the court's crisis. The letter expresses support for the president and concern over the impact of the crisis on institutional stability.

item.title: Quaest 1º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião no cenário com Pablo Marçal
item.description: Quaest poll for the 2026 first-round elections shows Lula leading with 36%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 29%. Pablo Marçal, deemed ineligible, receives 1%. The survey includes 13 candidates and was conducted between September 3-6 with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Cury reforça críticas ao STF em sabatina e diz não querer carreira política
item.description: In a CNN Brasil interview, presidential candidate Augusto Cury reinforced his criticism of the STF, advocating for a reform with eight-year terms and fewer justices. He opposed blanket pardons for January 8 convicts, saying he would review cases individually, and maintained his stance as an alternative to the Lula-Flávio Bolsonaro polarization.

item.title: Fachin adia reunião com OAB e alega excesso de demandas nesta semana
item.description: STF president Luiz Edson Fachin postponed a meeting with the OAB, citing high demand this week. The Supreme Court crisis involves leaked messages between Vorcaro and Moraes, raising OAB concerns about impacts on democratic institutions.

item.title: Reaças contra Xandão “flopam” na Paulista; Mendonça, Flávio e o STF
item.description: Right-wing protest on Paulista Avenue gathered 28,500 people, 32% fewer than in 2025 and 37% less than in 2024, according to USP/Cebrap Monitor. The mobilization, led by figures like Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio de Freitas, was deemed a 'flopam' despite criticism of the STF.

item.title: Presidente da OAB pede transparência e cobra respostas do STF em meio a crise na Corte; veja vídeo
item.description: The president of the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB), Beto Simonetti, called for quick and clear answers from the Supreme Federal Court (STF) following the crisis sparked by the revelation of messages between Justice Alexandre de Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro. He emphasized the need for transparency and institutional trust to ensure the country's democratic stability.

item.title: Os três trunfos de Flávio Bolsonaro em ato na Paulista no 7 de Setembro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's Paulista rally gathered over 28,000 people, enabling the candidate to take a more offensive stance against Lula by highlighting the STF crisis. The presence of allies like Tarcísio de Freitas and Nikolas Ferreira reinforced the unity of the right.

item.title: O número de Lula que aumenta nas pesquisas — e quem isso deve preocupar
item.description: A new Quaest survey shows Lula leading the first round with 36% of voter intent, but facing 53% rejection and 50% disapproval of his administration. In a hypothetical runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, both tie at 41%, indicating growing weakness in Lula's campaign.

item.title: RedeTV! News (05/09/26) | Completo
item.description: The September 5, 2026 episode of RedeTV! News presents the main news from Brazil and the world, covering diverse topics such as economy, security, health, and politics. Among the highlights, the inauguration of the new Directory of Hospital de Amor and an interview with Amália Costa, legal director of Volkswagen do Brasil, also stood out. The content is aimed at the general public, focusing on information of national and international interest.

item.title: Flávio recria espantalho da 'interferência' nas eleições
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, tied with Lula at 41% in a second-round scenario per Quaest, hinted on this September 7th that the electoral process could be subject to interference, without naming who or how.

item.title: Veja onde assistir Vitória x Grêmio ao vivo nesta segunda-feira (07)
item.description: The match between Vitória and Grêmio takes place this Monday (07), at 8 PM, at the Barradão stadium, in Salvador, in the 26th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship.

item.title: Quaest: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam numericamente com 41% no segundo turno
item.description: New Quaest poll released on April 7 shows a numerical tie between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 41% in a hypothetical runoff. Survey remains inconclusive, maintaining a balanced race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro evoca a su padre para movilizar a la derecha ante las elecciones y echar a Lula y al juez Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro rallied 28,000 supporters on Paulista Avenue during Brazil's 204th Independence Day, leveraging the event to kickstart the October elections. The senator evoked his jailed father Jair Bolsonaro, criticized Lula and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, and declared his aim to be the 'liberator of the homeland'. The rally featured support for Trump and foreign flags.

item.title: O pior sinal de alerta no painel do PT com a última pesquisa
item.description: The Quaest poll released on September 7th shows government disapproval rising from 48% to 50%, while approval dropped from 45% to 43%. Despite positive economic indicators, such as lower inflation and unemployment, Lula's candidacy faces warnings for not gaining expected electoral support.

item.title: Dino fala em causa própria para defender que lhe continue disponível o inquérito das fake news
item.description: Flávio Dino used his Instagram account to publicly defend Alexandre de Moraes and the continuation of the fake news investigation, arguing that lengthy judicial processes can be used as instruments of censorship and persecution, especially against critics and political opponents. He questions the impartiality of Supreme Court justices during political investigations, suggesting that the prolonged duration of these inquiries can be manipulated to favor certain groups or individuals.

item.title: Flávio lidera transferência de votos entre candidatos, aponta Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads in vote transfer in hypothetical runoff against Lula (PT). 59% of Romeu Zema (Novo) voters would support him. The former governor gained in voting intention.

item.title: Veja imagens de atos contra Moraes em várias cidades do Brasil
item.description: Protests against Minister Alexandre de Moraes took place in at least nine Brazilian capital cities on September 7, 2026, led by figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Silas Malafaia. The demonstrations gained momentum after the release of messages between Daniel Vorcaro and Moraes, drawing hundreds of thousands of people, including 34,200 in São Paulo.

item.title: Cury manda “abraço” a Mendonça e pede transparência no STF
item.description: Candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) expressed support for Minister André Mendonça and called for transparency at the STF during a public event in Copacabana, without directly mentioning other ministers. He also criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for lacking agricultural experience, positioning himself as an alternative to political polarization.

item.title: Fachin cancela reunião com OAB sobre crise no STF
item.description: STF president Edson Fachin canceled a meeting with the OAB regarding the court crisis after a PF report revealed ties between Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro. The OAB scheduled an urgent meeting to discuss the crisis, while the Supreme Court did not disclose the reason for the cancellation.

item.title: Moraes vira principal personagem do 7 de Setembro, mas só urnas vão definir futuro do STF
item.description: The STF crisis intensified after the September 7th demonstrations, with Alexandre De Moraes becoming the main focus of the dispute. With Lula and Flávio tied at 41% in voter intention, the wave of dissatisfaction falls on the minister rather than the PT candidate. The scenario remains static, awaiting the election results to define the future of the Supreme Court.

item.title: Veja como foi a segunda-feira (7) dos presidenciáveis
item.description: On Monday (7), the presidential candidates held events commemorating September 7, with speeches focused on security, economy, and women's inclusion in politics. Flávio Bolsonaro stood out by criticizing the STF and proposing tough measures such as reducing the age of criminal responsibility and chemical castration for rapists.

item.title: Manifestação de Flávio reúne 28,5 mil pessoas na Paulista, estima USP
item.description: The event organized by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Paulista Avenue gathered 28,500 people, according to estimates by USP/Cebrap and More in Common. The mobilization took place on September 7th holiday, showing a decrease compared to the previous year, when 42,200 people attended the same location.

item.title: Fachin cancela reunião com OAB em meio à crise no STF
item.description: Amid the STF crisis, the court's president, Minister Edson Fachin, canceled a meeting with OAB president Beto Simonetti, which was to address investigations involving ministers Alexandre de Moraes and André Mendonça regarding the Daniel Vorcaro case. Despite the postponement, Simonetti called an extraordinary meeting and emphasized the need for rigorous investigation of any misconduct by ministers.

item.title: Robô humanóide do Exército bate continência a Lula em desfile do 7 de Setembro
item.description: During the September 7th parade, a humanoid robot from the Military Institute of Engineering (IME) saluted President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, drawing attention on social media. The robot, part of AI and robotics research, was showcased in the military technology section. The government emphasized national sovereignty as the central theme of the event.

item.title: No 7 de setembro, pesquisa mostra que Flávio não avança, Lula é que anda de marcha ré
item.description: A Quaest poll on September 7 shows Lula losing ground, tying technically with Flavio Bolsonaro in the runoff (41% to 41%). Government approval fell to 43%, with disapproval at 50%, and the economy, particularly household debt, emerges as the main obstacle to Lula's fourth term.

item.title: STF forma maioria contra soltura de Bolsonaro
item.description: Two of the three ministers of the STF's First Chamber have already rejected the habeas corpus requesting the release of former President Jair Bolsonaro, securing a majority against his release before the trial is concluded. Carmen Lúcia, the rapporteur, and Cristiano Zanin voted against the request, with only Flávio Dino's vote remaining.

item.title: Na Avenida Paulista, Flávio Bolsonaro associa Moraes a Lula e diz que indicará ‘5 ministros’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro spoke on Paulista Avenue calling for the impeachment of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes and claimed he will appoint five justices if elected, linking Moraes to Lula's government. He also defended conservative stances such as harsher penalties for crimes and labeling criminal factions as terrorists.

item.title: Eduardo Leite sobre crescimento de Augusto Cury: ‘Apetite por algo diferente’
item.description: The governor of Rio Grande do Sul, Eduardo Leite (PSD), highlighted Augusto Cury’s (Avante) rise in the presidential race as evidence of demand for alternatives, while noting lingering resistance in a polarized context. He added that Rock in Rio boosts the local economy, creating over 20,000 temporary jobs.

item.title: Fio do Professor Felipe Nunes: análise da pesquisa Quaest para presidente de 7 de setembro
item.description: The Quaest survey released on September 7 shows Lula leading the first round with 36%, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 29%. In a simulated second round, the two candidates tie at 41% each, highlighting political polarization and 50% disapproval of Lula's administration.
